items.title: Unit 8 · Story
items.scene: Jim eats ten plates of ___, nine oranges, a pot of cheese, and one small ice cream cone.
items.prompt: Listen and choose the word.
items.spokenScene: Jim eats ten plates of rice, nine oranges, a pot of cheese, and one small ice cream cone.
items.storyText: Jim Giant lives in a city. He has a big cell phone and huge blue jeans. His lunch is huge, too! Jim eats ten plates of rice, nine oranges, a pot of cheese, and one small ice cream cone. He has a pet giraffe named Spot. Spot has a long nose and very long legs. He likes to eat roses. No, Spot! Don't eat that rose!
items.why: In “Jim Giant”, you hear: Jim eats ten plates of rice, nine oranges, a pot of cheese, and one small ice cream cone. The missing word is “rice”.
items.hint: Listen to this sentence again. Look at the story picture.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 4, Unit 8, p.79 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
